angle_offsets_note: Initial condition second entry is offset from pi in radians, converted before simulation.
disturbance_note: One seeded constant force pulse on [5,6) seconds, uniform [-2,2] N; same seed across controller variants.
settling_definition: Earliest logged time with |cart|<=0.05 m, |wrapped angle-pi|<=0.05 rad, |cart velocity|<=0.1 m/s, |angular velocity|<=0.1 rad/s and all later samples also within; at least 1 second must remain.
integration: Fixed-step RK4; continuous feedback recomputed at four RK stages. No sampled-data discretization or zero-order hold.
